title: Finding the subway station
scene: A traveler asks a woman on the street for directions

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 不好意思，请问这儿离地铁站远吗？
lines.py: Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐngwèn zhèr lí dìtiězhàn yuǎn ma?
lines.en: Excuse me, is the subway station far from here?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 不太远，走路10分钟就到了。
lines.py: Bú tài yuǎn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lines.en: Not too far. It's a ten-minute walk.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 怎么走呢？
lines.py: Zěnme zǒu ne?
lines.en: How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 你往前走，看见一个商场就往右走，地铁站在商场旁边。
lines.py: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, kànjiàn yí gè shāngchǎng jiù wǎng yòu zǒu, dìtiězhàn zài shāngchǎng pángbiān.
lines.en: Go straight, turn right when you see a shopping mall. The station is next to the mall.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我要去机场，坐地铁要多长时间？
lines.py: Wǒ yào qù jīchǎng, zuò dìtiě yào duō cháng shíjiān?
lines.en: I'm going to the airport. How long does it take by subway?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 要一个多小时。你也可以打车，但是打车很贵。
lines.py: Yào yí gè duō xiǎoshí. Nǐ yě kěyǐ dǎchē, dànshì dǎchē hěn guì.
lines.en: Over an hour. You could also take a taxi, but a taxi is expensive.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 没关系，我坐地铁。谢谢你！
lines.py: Méi guānxi, wǒ zuò dìtiě. Xièxie nǐ!
lines.en: That's fine, I'll take the subway. Thank you!

questions.prompt: 走路去地铁站要多长时间？
questions.promptPy: Zǒulù qù dìtiězhàn yào duō cháng shíjiān?
questions.promptEn: How long is the walk to the subway station?
questions.explanation: She says 走路10分钟就到了 in line 2. Over an hour is the subway ride to the airport.

questions.promptPy: Dìtiězhàn zài nǎr?
questions.promptEn: Where is the subway station?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says 地铁站在商场旁边.

questions.promptPy: Nán de yào qù nǎr?
questions.promptEn: Where is the man going?
questions.explanation: He says 我要去机场 in line 5.

questions.promptPy: Nán de yào zěnme qù jīchǎng?
questions.promptEn: How will the man get to the airport?
questions.explanation: Taxis are expensive, so in line 7 he says 我坐地铁.

title: Feeling unwell
scene: Two colleagues talk in the morning

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 你怎么了？今天是不是身体不舒服？
lines.py: Nǐ zěnme le? Jīntiān shì bu shì shēntǐ bù shūfu?
lines.en: What's wrong? Are you not feeling well today?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我头很疼，昨天晚上也没有睡好。
lines.py: Wǒ tóu hěn téng, zuótiān wǎnshang yě méiyǒu shuì hǎo.
lines.en: I have a bad headache, and I didn't sleep well last night.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 你去医院看看吧。
lines.py: Nǐ qù yīyuàn kànkan ba.
lines.en: You should go to the hospital and get checked.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我已经吃药了，我想在家休息一下。
lines.py: Wǒ yǐjīng chī yào le, wǒ xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi yíxià.
lines.en: I've already taken medicine. I want to rest at home for a bit.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那你今天别来公司了，多喝水。
lines.py: Nà nǐ jīntiān bié lái gōngsī le, duō hē shuǐ.
lines.en: Then don't come into the office today. Drink lots of water.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好。下午的会我不能去了，你帮我告诉大家吧。
lines.py: Hǎo. Xiàwǔ de huì wǒ bù néng qù le, nǐ bāng wǒ gàosu dàjiā ba.
lines.en: OK. I can't make the afternoon meeting. Could you tell everyone for me?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好的，你好好休息。
lines.py: Hǎo de, nǐ hǎohǎo xiūxi.
lines.en: Sure. Get some good rest.

questions.promptPy: Nán de nǎr bù shūfu?
questions.promptEn: What is bothering the man?
questions.explanation: He says 我头很疼 in line 2.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de ràng nán de qù nǎr?
questions.promptEn: Where does the woman tell the man to go?
questions.explanation: She says 你去医院看看吧 in line 3.

questions.promptPy: Nán de jīntiān xiǎng zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does the man want to do today?
questions.explanation: He has taken medicine and says 我想在家休息一下 in line 4.

questions.promptPy: Nán de ràng nǚ de zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explanation: He can't go to the meeting and asks 你帮我告诉大家吧 in line 6.

title: Mom's birthday
scene: A daughter talks about plans for her mother's birthday

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 下个星期六是我妈妈的生日。
lines.py: Xià ge xīngqīliù shì wǒ māma de shēngrì.
lines.en: Next Saturday is my mom's birthday.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我和爸爸准备在家给她过生日。
lines.py: Wǒ hé bàba zhǔnbèi zài jiā gěi tā guò shēngrì.
lines.en: Dad and I are planning to celebrate it at home.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 爸爸做饭做得很好，那天他会做妈妈最喜欢的鱼。
lines.py: Bàba zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo, nà tiān tā huì zuò māma zuì xǐhuan de yú.
lines.en: Dad is a good cook. That day he'll make Mom's favorite fish.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我想送妈妈一块手表。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng sòng māma yí kuài shǒubiǎo.
lines.en: I wanted to give Mom a watch.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 但是手表要一千块，我没有那么多钱。
lines.py: Dànshì shǒubiǎo yào yìqiān kuài, wǒ méiyǒu nàme duō qián.
lines.en: But a watch costs a thousand kuai, and I don't have that much money.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 所以我准备送她一些花。
lines.py: Suǒyǐ wǒ zhǔnbèi sòng tā yìxiē huā.
lines.en: So I'm going to give her some flowers.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 妈妈非常喜欢红色，我要买红色的花。
lines.py: Māma fēicháng xǐhuan hóngsè, wǒ yào mǎi hóngsè de huā.
lines.en: Mom really likes red, so I'll buy red flowers.

questions.promptPy: Māma de shēngrì shì nǎ tiān?
questions.promptEn: When is Mom's birthday?
questions.explanation: Line 1 says 下个星期六是我妈妈的生日.

questions.promptPy: Bàba nà tiān huì zuò shénme cài?
questions.promptEn: What dish will Dad make that day?
questions.explanation: Line 3 says he will make 妈妈最喜欢的鱼.

questions.promptPy: Tā wèi shénme bù mǎi shǒubiǎo?
questions.promptEn: Why isn't she buying the watch?
questions.explanation: Line 5 says the watch costs 一千块 and she doesn't have that much money.

questions.promptPy: Tā yào mǎi shénme yánsè de huā?
questions.promptEn: What color flowers will she buy?
questions.explanation: Line 7 says Mom likes red, so she will buy 红色的花.

title: Favorite sports
scene: Two classmates talk about what they do for exercise

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你有什么爱好？
lines.py: Nǐ yǒu shénme àihào?
lines.en: What are your hobbies?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我喜欢游泳，每个星期去游两次。
lines.py: Wǒ xǐhuan yóuyǒng, měi gè xīngqī qù yóu liǎng cì.
lines.en: I like swimming. I go twice a week.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我游得不好，我喜欢踢足球。
lines.py: Wǒ yóu de bù hǎo, wǒ xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
lines.en: I'm not a good swimmer. I like playing soccer.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 你经常踢吗？
lines.py: Nǐ jīngcháng tī ma?
lines.en: Do you play often?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我和同学们每天都踢一个小时。
lines.py: Wǒ hé tóngxuémen měitiān dōu tī yí gè xiǎoshí.
lines.en: My classmates and I play for an hour every day.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 运动对身体很好。这个星期天我们一起去跑步吧？
lines.py: Yùndòng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo. Zhège xīngqītiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù pǎobù ba?
lines.en: Exercise is good for you. Shall we go running together this Sunday?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好啊！早上七点在学校门口见。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Zǎoshang qī diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jiàn.
lines.en: Sure! See you at the school gate at seven in the morning.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?
questions.promptEn: What sport does the woman like?
questions.explanation: She says 我喜欢游泳 in line 2. Soccer is the man's sport.

questions.prompt: 女的一个星期游泳几次？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de yí gè xīngqī yóuyǒng jǐ cì?
questions.promptEn: How many times a week does the woman swim?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says 每个星期去游两次.

questions.prompt: 男的每天踢多长时间足球？
questions.promptPy: Nán de měitiān tī duō cháng shíjiān zúqiú?
questions.promptEn: How long does the man play soccer each day?
questions.explanation: Line 5 says 每天都踢一个小时.

questions.promptPy: Tāmen xīngqītiān zài nǎr jiàn?
questions.promptEn: Where will they meet on Sunday?
questions.explanation: Line 7 says 在学校门口见.

title: Buying trousers
scene: A customer and a shop assistant in a clothing store

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 这条裤子很好看，有大一点儿的吗？
lines.py: Zhè tiáo kùzi hěn hǎokàn, yǒu dà yìdiǎnr de ma?
lines.en: These trousers look nice. Do you have a bigger size?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 有，你穿多大的？
lines.py: Yǒu, nǐ chuān duō dà de?
lines.en: Yes. What size do you wear?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我个子很高，要最大的。
lines.py: Wǒ gèzi hěn gāo, yào zuì dà de.
lines.en: I'm tall, so I need the biggest one.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好，这条是最大的。你喜欢黑色还是白色？
lines.py: Hǎo, zhè tiáo shì zuì dà de. Nǐ xǐhuan hēisè háishi báisè?
lines.en: OK, this is the biggest. Do you prefer black or white?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 黑色的。多少钱？
lines.py: Hēisè de. Duōshao qián?
lines.en: Black. How much is it?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 四百块。今天买两条，六百块就可以。
lines.py: Sìbǎi kuài. Jīntiān mǎi liǎng tiáo, liùbǎi kuài jiù kěyǐ.
lines.en: Four hundred kuai. Today you can get two pairs for six hundred.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那我要两条，一条黑色的，一条白色的。
lines.py: Nà wǒ yào liǎng tiáo, yì tiáo hēisè de, yì tiáo báisè de.
lines.en: Then I'll take two, one black and one white.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好的，请跟我来。
lines.py: Hǎo de, qǐng gēn wǒ lái.
lines.en: Sure, please come with me.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de yào mǎi shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does the woman want to buy?
questions.explanation: Line 1 is about 这条裤子.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de wèi shénme yào zuì dà de?
questions.promptEn: Why does the woman want the biggest size?
questions.explanation: Line 3 says 我个子很高，要最大的.

questions.promptPy: Yì tiáo kùzi duōshao qián?
questions.promptEn: How much is one pair of trousers?
questions.explanation: Line 6 says 四百块. Six hundred is the price for two.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de mǎile jǐ tiáo?
questions.promptEn: How many pairs does the woman buy?
questions.explanation: Line 7 says 我要两条, one black and one white.

title: A new school year
scene: A high school student talks about his new school

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我今年上高中了。
lines.py: Wǒ jīnnián shàng gāozhōng le.
lines.en: I started high school this year.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 新学校离我家很远，坐公交车要40分钟。
lines.py: Xīn xuéxiào lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn, zuò gōngjiāochē yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
lines.en: My new school is far from home. It takes forty minutes by bus.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 所以我每天早上六点就起床了。
lines.py: Suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
lines.en: So I get up at six every morning.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我们班有四十个学生，老师和同学都很好。
lines.py: Wǒmen bān yǒu sìshí gè xuésheng, lǎoshī hé tóngxué dōu hěn hǎo.
lines.en: There are forty students in my class. The teachers and classmates are all nice.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我最喜欢上汉语课，因为汉语老师经常给我们说有意思的事。
lines.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan shàng Hànyǔ kè, yīnwèi Hànyǔ lǎoshī jīngcháng gěi wǒmen shuō yǒu yìsi de shì.
lines.en: My favorite class is Chinese, because the Chinese teacher often tells us interesting things.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 下午五点下课，我和同学们一起去打篮球。
lines.py: Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn xiàkè, wǒ hé tóngxuémen yìqǐ qù dǎ lánqiú.
lines.en: Classes end at five in the afternoon, and I play basketball with my classmates.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 虽然很累，但是我很快乐。
lines.py: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ hěn kuàilè.
lines.en: It's tiring, but I'm happy.

questions.promptPy: Tā zěnme qù xuéxiào?
questions.promptEn: How does he get to school?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says 坐公交车要40分钟.

questions.promptPy: Tāmen bān yǒu duōshao xuésheng?
questions.promptEn: How many students are in his class?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says 我们班有四十个学生.

questions.prompt: 他为什么最喜欢汉语课？
questions.promptPy: Tā wèi shénme zuì xǐhuan Hànyǔ kè?
questions.promptEn: Why is Chinese his favorite class?
options: 老师经常说有意思的事
questions.explanation: Line 5 gives the reason with 因为: the teacher 经常给我们说有意思的事.

questions.promptPy: Tā jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
questions.promptEn: What time do his classes end?
questions.explanation: Line 6 says 下午五点下课. Six is when he gets up.
